description: FreeWheel GET ad requests on *.v.fwmrm.net/ad/g/. Global contracts apply to the first query group. SDK Type B temporal slots in later groups receive independent required-field and unique-ID checks. Legacy flat fields and the partial group1 VMAP slot retain optional validation. Account authorization and raw transport variants remain external or explicitly unmapped.

params.name: nw
params.description: It is the distributor network ID. FreeWheel documents setNetwork as required, and that call sets nw on the ad request.
params.fix_hint: Set nw to the network ID from your FreeWheel sales engineer.

params.name: csid
params.description: It is a custom site section ID. FreeWheel setSiteSection with a custom id sets csid. FreeWheel ids use ssid instead.
params.fix_hint: Send csid for a custom site section, or ssid for a FreeWheel site section id.

params.name: ssid
params.description: It is a FreeWheel site section ID. FreeWheel setSiteSection with a FreeWheel id sets ssid.
params.fix_hint: Send ssid for a FreeWheel site section id, or csid for a custom one.

params.name: caid
params.description: It is the custom video asset ID. FreeWheel setVideoAsset with ID_TYPE_CUSTOM sets caid on the ad request.
params.fix_hint: Send caid for a custom asset id, or asid for a FreeWheel asset id.

params.name: asid
params.description: It is the FreeWheel video asset ID. FreeWheel setVideoAsset with ID_TYPE_FW sets asid on the ad request.
params.fix_hint: Send asid for a FreeWheel asset id, or caid for a custom one.

params.name: flag
params.description: It is the player capability flags. FreeWheel setCapability and setVideoAsset autoPlayType write flag on the ad request.
params.fix_hint: Send flag as the capability string the player supports, such as +play-uapl, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: prof
params.description: It is the player profile. FreeWheel setProfile sets prof on the ad request. Uplynk documents ad.prof as required on the constructed GET.
params.fix_hint: Send prof as the player profile from FreeWheel, such as 14611:Vod.

params.name: asnw
params.description: FreeWheel documents asnw as a numeric network, fallback, or candidate ad identifier.

params.name: ssnw
params.description: FreeWheel documents ssnw as a numeric network, fallback, or candidate ad identifier.

params.name: afid
params.description: FreeWheel SDK accepts nonempty string fallback IDs. The HTML5 reference describes numeric IDs, so a nonnumeric fallback ID is advisory.
params.fix_hint: Use the fallback ID configured in FreeWheel. The SDK accepts string IDs.

params.name: sfid
params.description: FreeWheel SDK accepts nonempty string fallback IDs. The HTML5 reference describes numeric IDs, so a nonnumeric fallback ID is advisory.
params.fix_hint: Use the fallback ID configured in FreeWheel. The SDK accepts string IDs.

params.description: FreeWheel serializes candidate ad IDs as a comma-separated list. Each candidate ID is a nonnegative integer.
